name: eu-mrv-2024
note: Container ship factor from EU MRV data (Regulation (EU) 2015/757), reporting period 2024, as published by EMSA (THETIS-MRV, version 252 of 15-10-2026). Source: European Maritime Safety Agency; reproduction authorised with acknowledgement of the source.

legs.source: EU MRV 2024 (EMSA THETIS-MRV, version 252 of 15-10-2026): 1993 container ships with full-year reports, 8312 billion tonne-km. TTW: all CO2e (CO2, CH4, N2O) they reported divided by their transport work (cargo mass x distance actually sailed). WTT: their fuel x DESNZ 2026 marine fuel oil well-to-tank (714.9 kg CO2e/t).
